notes.title: The results of Next Fest 2021.
notes.content:
This is KV4 Studio. Thank you to everyone who played the demo. We have received a lot of feedback about [b]Factory Defense[/b]. You have helped us to understand the main drawbacks of the game, as well as to identify serious bugs. The game is sent for long-term revision, namely:
[list]
[*] The bugs found will be fixed.
[*] A clear tutorial will be created
[*] The opening content will be improved
[*] The game will be sped up
[/list]
We are sorry that the demo did not meet your expectations. We will try to fix everything. Expect an update.

(sorry again)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41008838/aaf405ad99fae5598b1ba0d6882e1d871764c515.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo update. Bug fix 3
notes.content: We have fixed a bug that breaks the workbench.

notes.title: Demo update. Bug fix 2
notes.content: We added the ability to disable head shaking when walking, sped up crafting and fixed bugs in the workbench.

notes.title: Demo update. Bug fix 1
notes.content: We have fixed frequently occurring bugs. And also at the request of users added new functions. The update is already available in Steam.

notes.title: Factory Defense at Next Fest 2021
notes.content:
Next Fest 2021 is taking place right now. These are hundreds of demos for future games. You can download the Factory Defense demo right now from the Steam store page. Share your gaming experience on our social media and Steam community.
Demo features:
-Disable network mode
-Content limited
-Disabled saving
